content:
Subject: Request for Late Submission of Lab Report

Dear Dr. Khan,

I am writing to inform you that I was unable to attend the lab session on 22 March due to a sudden family emergency; my younger brother was hospitalized and I had to be with my family. I understand the importance of timely lab work and sincerely apologise for any inconvenience caused.

I kindly request permission to submit the lab report for the "Electrochemistry" experiment by 5 April. I will ensure the work meets the required standards and will be grateful for your understanding.

Thank you for considering my request. I look forward to your response.

Sincerely,
Ayesha Malik
Electrical Engineering, Year 1
University of Karachi

viva.summary: The student demonstrates a solid understanding of the email's purpose, can articulate each line, predict how to adapt the content for a different reason, and condense the message while preserving politeness. Minor improvement could be made in tightening language even further.

rubric.revise_next: Next, try experimenting with different levels of formality and brevity to strengthen your professional writing style.

questions.answer: Main Dr. Khan se guzarish kar rahi hoon ke mujhe Electrochemistry ka lab report 5 April tak submit karne ki permission mile, kyunke us din tak mujhe family emergency se settle ho jaane ka waqt mil jayega aur main report ko achi tarah complete kar sakungi.
questions.feedback: You clearly explained that you are asking for permission to submit the report by 5 April because you will be able to finish it after the family emergency.
questions.prompt: You wrote, "I kindly request permission to submit the lab report for the \"Electrochemistry\" experiment by 5 April." What exactly are you requesting here, and why do you consider this date appropriate?

questions.answer: Agar main bimar ho kar lab miss karun, tou email mein main likhungi: "I was unable to attend the lab session on 22 March due to a sudden illness; I was feverish and needed rest." Baaki sab structure same hi rahega – apology, request for extension, and thanks.
questions.feedback: You correctly described how you would change the reason to a sudden illness while keeping the same apology, request, and thanks.
questions.prompt: If you had to miss a lab due to a sudden illness instead of a family emergency, how would you modify the request in your email while keeping the same structure?

questions.answer:
Dear Dr. Khan,

I couldn't attend the lab on 22 March due to a family emergency (my brother was hospitalized). Could I please submit the Electrochemistry report by 5 April? I apologise for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

Thank you,
Ayesha Malik
questions.feedback: Your shortened version stays under 100 words, keeps the essential request and polite tone, and removes only non‑essential details.
questions.prompt: If the teacher required a shorter email of no more than 100 words, how would you modify the body of your email while keeping the essential request and politeness?
